about_the_game:
Tales of the Withered is a choice-driven RPG set in the low-fantasy world of Wither, where a supernatural curse, called the “Withering”, has poisoned the soil and left the residents sick and starving. Take the role of a mysterious girl who wanders in from the wilderness, with no memory and no voice, but with a strange power that may cleanse the land of the curse. Meet the people, master the arts of man and the ways of nature, and decide the ultimate fate of Wither.

FEATURES

  • Make choices to build your affinity with the fierce will of Nature or the fragile hope of Humanity, shifting the nature of your own powers, and the fate of the village. 

  • Gorgeous low-fantasy setting, beautifully experienced in vivid first-person. A rich carefully curated soundtrack that draws you entirely into the cursed town and the surrounding wilds.

  • Bond with the misery-heavy villagers of Wither, uncovering their personalities, their stories, their secrets - and your own. 

  • Use your mysterious powers to grow crops and herbs, even in ruined soil. Brew potions of healing and cook food for the starving village. Sell what remains, invest and upgrade. 

  • Explore the eerie wilds around Wither, carefully gathering resources and avoiding prowling animals… as well as the darker shapes lurking between the trees. Or perhaps those are exactly what you are looking for. 

Sustain the village by managing shared resources - keeping Wither supplied with food, clean water and medicine as its survival increasingly depends on you.

WILL YOU AID THE TATTERED REMNANTS OF THE VILLAGE…?

The people of Wither cannot survive without your help. Use your newfound powers that you are slowly discovering to grow food, chase away wild animals and brew potions to keep the village alive. Bit by bit, Wither and its villagers can rebuild themselves, and come back from the brink.

…OR WILL YOU LEAVE THE VILLAGE TO BE RETAKEN BY THE WILDS?



The Withering is a curse born of human greed; digging too deep, taking too much, giving nothing in return. There are shadows in the woods with flickering eyes and towering horns that think the time of the village has run its course. The time has come for it all to return to the trees. Maybe you agree with these shadows. Maybe your magical gifts are meant to clean away the last of the mess these humans have left behind.

content_descriptors.notes: The story follows the fate of a decaying village. The game contains some mention of starvation, disease and death.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 (4 cores @ 3.2 GHz) or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 (3 GB) or AMD R9 390
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: None
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600K (4 cores @ 3.8 GHz) or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 (8 GB) or AMD RX 580 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: None

short_description: Save the town and people of Wither - or let the forest dwindle them away. Tales of the Withered is a deep, story-driven adventure RPG focusing on a humble community plagued by a mysterious poison, and a mute teenager who may be the key to curing the earth.
